h1: Custom Hit Paper Bags for Branded Packaging
metaTitle: Custom Hit Paper Bags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom Hit paper bags with your logo. Perfect for retail, takeout, and events. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Hit paper bags offer a sturdy, eco-friendly packaging solution for businesses that need reliable branding on a budget. From small 6" x 8" pup bags for boutique items to large 16" x 12" shopper bags for retail or takeout, Hit's range includes white kraft and eco shopper options. Imprint your logo in one or two colors for a clean, professional look that stands out at checkout counters or trade shows.
heroAltText: Custom Hit paper bags with company logo printed on white kraft and eco shopper styles in various sizes.
